book.name: Lucas
book.title: LUCAS Luca vara bivani'aki ida Jesus monina jahaki

content: Jaharia bikaboroboroki
ada Jesus
Hari. Jordão vaini onikia ajihi'aha ada Jesus. Ma'onahai Jahaki Jesus va'i-ra nahonariahihivini. Ma'onahai Jahakia biavikha'aha ada Jesus amasia. 40 mahi hoja'aha. Kaija'aririhi ida amasi.

Ni-nahina-ra haki. 'Bairina mani ida Jesu-ra navai'ami'ia. Oniaroa, okha'aha ada Jahari Jesus kania. Bikaboroboro'aha ada Jesus bada bini'aja kaimoni ida badani Deua binofiriki. Jesua ni-bikapoaripa'itxiki ida athi.
Jaharia bini'aha: —Deus kaisai ihihi; ja'di-ra 'bai aniha'a.
Jesua bini'aha: —Iniani. Ni-Deus hora honariaki ja'di-ra 'bai oanihavini. Deus athi kapapirania hojaki ida athi:

content.text: Deus athi hahavi-ra anaabavini mani ida ija'ari-ra nahokija.”

content: — Jesua bini'aha ada Jahari.
Oniaroa, arabo namahikia Jaharia biavikhaha ada Jesus, binanokiahivini vihiha adani arabo hahavi kaija'arini, vakadiarabo hiki. Jorakia binanokiahiha.

Bini'aha ada Jesus: —Va'ora ohonariaha'oadahaki adani ija'ari hahavi, vakadika'da'di ohiki ho. Hora kanamasivi'a bana! Hora ikanamasivihi; va'ora ihonariavini va'ora ova'ahaha vakadika'da'di ihija kaimoni. Vakadinahina kaidivakia ira ono'ahi jaboni. Ogathanihi ida arabo hahavi, ohonariaki ida ija'ari hahavi, vakadika'da'di vihiki, kodibadani-ra bada vani'ara kaimoni. Kodiani hahavi adani ija'ari. Hoariha ka'da'di hina-ra onofihi; ova'ahaha. Hora ikanamasivihi; vakadika'da'di ihini-ra ova'ahahi — niha ada Jahari, Jesu-ra kaborovini, bada bini'aja kaimoni ida Deua bivajahariki.
Hari. Jesua bini'aha: —Iniani. Jokoa ira okanamasivirihi. Deus athi kapapirania hojaki ida athi haria nava'isohiki kaimoni:
— Jesua bini'aha ada Jahari.

Oniaroa, Jerusalém sidajia Jaharia biavikhaha ija'ari Deu-ra khai vani'avini kagorani 'da'dini a'ani sohiriama'oki kania, bini'aha: —Araofarari'a bana nabo'ajaja. Deus kaisai ihini mani ida ira akadava'ajahakivini hija, iahaharia kaimoni.
Deus athi kapapirania bini'aki:

content.text: “Deus va'ora honariaki adani ibavi kaija'arini kadania ira avagathanivini,

content: Nimania ida Deus athi — Jaharia bini'aha. Asia vara niki ada Jahari: —Deus kaisai ihihi; araofarari'a nabo'ajaja mahija Deus ira akadava'avini-ra ikaijo'avini.
Jesua bigathanihi ida athi: —Iniani. Jokoa iathini-ra onaabarihi. Jokoa oaraofararirihi. Deus athi haria nava'isohiki hari jaboni:

content.text: iogaja kaimoni ida Deus hojana kadania.”

content: Oniaroa, hari hi'imidia'ihi ida Jesus Jaharia bikaboroborovini. Jesua ni-binaabaki ida Jahari athi. Ajihi'aha ada Jahari. Binokhahi ida mahi hoariha Jesu-ra kaboroboro'ianavini kamahini kaimoni.
Jesus kabadani kama'dani Galiléia kaarabonia
Hari. Galiléia kaarabonia ajoi'aha ada Jesus. Ma'onahai Jahaki danona Jesus va'i-ra nahonariahihiha. Ija'ari hahavia vakamithaki ida Jesus varani hina Galiléia kaarabonia.
Judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania, Jesus va'ora ka'ojomo'ibakhiaki adani ija'ari vajoroniki. Vakamithava vara vaabono vakani'akhama'aha: —Jahaki ida Jesus kavarani.
Nazaré sidajia okhaha
ada Jesus

Hari. Okha'aha ada Jesus Nazaré sidajia, ibavi bivavijavaki kania. Jesus hojana hiki ida judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania okhana avakoirina kamahini. Oniania, okhajakosi'aha ada Jesus, vithi'aha. Hojana oadani, gaamanani'aha vara bivani'aja kaimoni ida Deus athi kapapirani.

Deus athi kapapirani akadava'ava abonoa biarakha'ihi ida Deus athi kapapira pitani Jesus kania. Isaías kohana athi kapapirani ida. Jesua biarabikhaihi, bikaraga'ihi ida athii pitani Cristo varani hina-ra vava'isohihijoravini. Niha:

content.text: jaboni va'ora oakava'ijoara kaimoni adani ija'ari
jaboni va'ora vara oni'ara kaimoni adani ija'ari

content: Nimania ida Isaías kohana athi — vara niha ada Jesus.

Jesua binahoja'imidia'ihi ida papira. Deus athi kapapirani akadava'ava abono-ra no'avini hi'ihi. Vithi'ianaha ada Jesus. Ija'ari judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania vajoroniki Jesu-ra vada vani'ahaha'oadaha'aha.
Jesus va'ora ni'aha: —Deus hora nagathogathovini hiki bada oni'aja kaimoni ida badani athi kapapirania vara a'onira oni'avini hi'iki.

Varani-ra vakamitha'iki vaabono vara vakani'akhama'iki: —Jahaki o Jesus. Avajahaki ida vara bivani'a'iki athi. Akava'ibodivaraniki ida kidivarani jahaki. José kaisai mani koda ada Jesus? Nihaniki vania biogaja ida Deus athi nahina hini? — vaabono vakani'akhama'aha.
Jesus va'ora ni'aha: —Hora vara avani'aki bana a'oni varani pa'itxia.
Hora avani'aki bana jaboni a'oni:

content.text: bada ini'a jaboni ida kadabadani danoki.”

content: — Hora avani'aki bana a'oni.
Asia vara niki ada Jesus: — A'onira onava'isohiki bana ho. Deus athi namoniva abono-ra vagathanijahakiriha adani ibavi bivavijavaki kasidajini kaija'arini.

Mitha vakhani'a. Vara ovani'aki ada Deus athi namoniva abono Elias kohana varani hina. Kidija'aria vagathanijahakiriha ada Elias kohana. Elias hokina kari Deu-ra kanikharia'iki ada. Badara ahoarabakosiki khararijanariha ada bahi. Vai'ami abani vihi'iki adani arabo kaija'arini hahavi. Vaipohiki adani kaariha Israel kaija'ari vahararana vahojaki, vakainamoki ida vakadi'bai.

Kaba'i, ni-Israel kaija'ari kaariha vihiki vakadiania Deua bikarona'iki ada Elias okhana. Arabo hoariha kaija'arini kaariha kania Deua bikarona'iki ada Elias, Sarepta sidajia okhana, Sidom kaarabonia.

Vara ovani'aki jaboni ada Deus athi namoniva abono hoariha Eliseu oniki. Kidija'aria vagathanijahakiriha ada Eliseu kohana. Eliseu hokina kari vaipohiki adani ija'ari asafi namani-ra najaharikia vakavamoniki, Israel kaija'ari vahararana vahojaki. Ni-Deus va'ora anaihotaki. Naamã hoarana Síria kaaraboni kaija'ari vani ada Deua binajaha'ara. A'onivani fori hiki hida oabono vara ovani'avini. Deus athi namoniva abono ohina mani ida oibavi ovavijavaki kasidajini kaija'arini hora vagathanijahakiravini hija — va'ora ni'aha ada Jesus.
Jesus athi-ra mitha vani'aha adani ija'ari vajoroniki judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania, vavajahari'ihi ida kidivarani, vaihamahikaraho'aha.

Oniaroa, vigaamanani'aha, Jesu-ra vagathi'aha avarahokaonani'aha sidaji banininija. Arabo namahiki kania hojaki ida Nazaré sidaji. Jesu-ra avavikha'aha. Ipa'ita namahiki kania vanofiki ida Jesu-ra avarokojohofonivini abinira kaimoni.
Ni-vakaabokaki avarokojohofonivini. Radaha'oamani'aha ada Jesus ija'ari vaipohiki vahararana, ajihi'aha.
Jesua bianaihotaki ada makhira kabajadiki

Hari. Okha'aha ada Jesus Cafarnaum sidajia Galiléia kaarabonia. Akhano'aha, hoja'aha. Avakoirina kamahini judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania avi'oi'aha. Va'ora ka'ojomo'i'aha adani ija'ari vajoroni'iki.
Vakava'ibodivaraniki ida va'ora ka'ojomo'ivini niha ninini Jesua biogajahakiki ida nahina Deua binofiki, oniani ida Deus athia va'ora ka'ojomo'ijahakivini hija.
Oniaroa, judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania hojaha ada makhira kabajadiki. Bodi'baraha'aha:
—Jesus, nahina hida akadiania inofija? Haria inihimamaniki i koda? Ira oogaki ho. Ivani ijahaka'oaki i, Deus ira karonaki i — makhira bini'aha ada Jesus.

Oniaroa, Jesua bikaabani'ihi ida bajadi: —Avisoni'a! Makhira kania akara'o'a bana! Hari. Bajadia binarai'aha ada makhira vajoroniki vaviaha, ajihi'ihi ida bajadi. Ni-makhanina hojaroni'iki ada makhira.

Vahoariha mitha vani'a'ihi, vakava'ibodivarani'ihi ida Jesus kavarani. Vaabono vakani'akhama'aha: —Nahina nimania ida Jesus kavarani. Ka'da'di oamani ada. Danoki ida kidibadani. Bikaabokaki ida bajadi akara'o'ini ija'ari kania. Bajadia binaaba'iki ida athi — vaabono vakani'akhama'aha.
Galiléia kaarabonia akarafarakhamaki ida Jesus monina.
Jesus aihotahi abono hina kavaranihi

Hari. Judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania ajihi'aha ada Jesus. Simão gorana okha'aha. Kaikahi'aha gora bodinia o'oi'aha. Kabaravakarahoki ida Simão kamasodini. Simão Jesu-ra vara vani'avini hi'ini hida kidikavamoni.
Oniaroa, bivi'omaki kania okhamiha ada Jesus. Bini'ahi: —Barava, akara'o'a gamo kania! Jorakia radaha'ihi ida kidibarava. Gama'ihi ida Simão kamasodini. Va'ora kahinanika'ihi.

Hari. Mithani vaivaini vani, Jesus kania ija'ari va'ora vavikha'aha adani vakadiva'ahi vakavamoniki. Ipohiki ida vakadikavamoni. Jesus va'ora kaabadaronaha'aha adani ija'ari vakavamoniki, va'ora anaihota'aha.

Vahararana vahojaki adani ija'ari vakabajadiki. Ija'ari vakadiania avakara'o'aha adani bajadi, vabodi'baraha'aha: —Jesus, ivani ka'da'di i! Deus kaisai i! Bajadia avigaki ada aihotahi abono Deua bikarona'iki, oniani ida vara vakhanijanarina Jesus va'ora kaabanivini hija.
Jesus monina hida

Hari. Oniaroa, ka'afokajomani vagavagani sidajia okhaonani'aha ada Jesus. Kaija'aririki kani-ra anikhaha'avini. Akhano'aha hoja'aha. Ija'ari Jesu-ra vanako'dihavini, vakaraga'aha amasia. Vanofirihi ida Jesus ajihina ibavi hoariha okhana.

Oniania, ija'ari vaipohiki-ra va'ora ni'aha ada Jesus: —Sidaji ipohiki, ija'ari vahoariha vakadiania ookhaki ho. Nini vani Deua binofija ida. Va'ora okanamonivini hiki Deus ija'ari hahavi-ra vaka'da'divini kavaranihia. Binofiki ida ija'ari hahavi-ra vaka'da'divini, vakamithahahavija kaimoni ida Deus athi — va'ora ni'aha ada Jesus.
Oniaroa, ibavi hahavia aadahaoni'aha ada Jesus. Judeus kaija'ari Deu-ra vara vani'avini kagorania va'ora aka'ojomo'ionivini, va'ora kanamonivini hi'ihi ida Deus athi.
